_readme: S720 lever (the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever, run 45319725062): Los Angeles Southwest College's 9 programs whose extraction placed none of the state's listed courses were handed a sibling award's section or the course descriptions (02862 02877 10738 19186 24277 33868 38597 40275 40947). This plan prints every page of the college's 2026-27 catalog PDF, the file the capture reads (250 pages, 5517393 bytes at capture 39061735776), line for line, so a session downloads the whole log (gh run view --log), finds each program's own section and names its pdf_pages pin, or files it as a named gap. One load, no model call, nothing written.

questions.own_page: Where each program's own section opens (its heading and the first line of its requirement list) and where its list ends (its total), so a pdf_pages pin can name the page, the words it opens on and the page it runs through.
